articles.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Joins A Major Enterprise AI Infrastructure Build
articles.summary: Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI) announced a new partnership with Cisco to supply high density liquid and air cooled compute systems for AI infrastructure. The company’s systems will be integrated into Cisco’s Secure AI Factory architecture, which uses NVIDIA technologies for enterprise, neocloud and sovereign cloud customers. The collaboration broadens Super Micro Computer’s access to rack scale and dense GPU systems that are validated for Cisco’s AI offerings. Consider broadening your...

articles.title: The Real Risk Inside Cisco Stock
articles.summary: The company is firing on all cylinders, but its biggest success story, the networking super cycle, carries a vulnerability that could challenge its premium price.

articles.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
articles.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock is back in focus after the company and partners Cisco and HUMAIN outlined plans to deploy up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure in Saudi Arabia starting in 2027. Despite the Saudi AI announcement and other partnerships around secure AI infrastructure, Advanced Micro Devices’ recent share price has eased, with the 7-day share price return down 4.08% and the 90-day share price return down 15.28%. articles.summary: Cisco and IBM both cut dividend checks to shareholders this month, but one company earns a grade that might surprise income investors who judge payouts by yield alone.

articles.title: The AI Infrastructure Stock Nobody Talks About Enough
articles.summary: Cisco is posting hyperscaler AI order numbers that would make pure-play networking rivals jealous, yet its valuation still reflects a company selling switches to office parks. Something in that gap deserves a closer look.

articles.title: 3 Reasons CSCO is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
articles.summary: Cisco has had an impressive run over the past six months as its shares have beaten the S&P 500 by 26.4%. The stock now trades at $109.75, marking a 38.2% gain. This was partly due to its solid quarterly results, and the run-up might have investors contemplating their next move.
